input: Write daily micro-fiction prompts for thirty days

gold.taskTitle: Write Thirty Days of Micro-Fiction Prompts
gold.taskDescription: Create a complete set of daily micro-fiction prompts spanning thirty consecutive days.

questions.title: What is the target word count per micro-fiction piece?
questions.description: Understand the length constraint for each story (e.g., 50 words, 100 words, 280 characters).

questions.title: Who is the intended audience writing from these prompts?
questions.description: Identify whether the prompts are for yourself, a community, a class, or a public challenge.

questions.title: Is there a unifying theme across all thirty days?
questions.description: Determine if all prompts should share a genre, mood, or overarching concept.

questions.title: What format should each prompt take?
questions.description: Clarify whether prompts are single words, sentences, images, first lines, or scenario setups.

questions.title: Where will you publish or share these prompts daily?
questions.description: Identify the platform so prompts can be tailored in tone and length (e.g., Instagram, Twitter, a blog, a newsletter).

questions.title: Do you want all thirty prompts written upfront or one per day?
questions.description: Determine the production schedule — batch all in advance or draft them on a rolling daily basis.

questions.title: Are there any genres or topics that must be avoided?
questions.description: Note any content restrictions, sensitivities, or excluded themes to keep prompts appropriate for the audience.
